label: LassoCRM
description: Manage registrants, contact details, notes, activities, appointments and inventory

operations.name: list_registrants
operations.description: Read one page of registrants; use next_cursor for the next page.

operations.name: search_registrants
operations.description: Search one page of registrants by name, email, phone or external ID.

operations.name: get_registrant
operations.description: Retrieve full registrant data; history bodies require their separate API.

operations.name: create_registrant
operations.description: Submit a new registrant; HTTP 202 acknowledges acceptance, not completed processing.

operations.name: update_registrant
operations.description: Update registrant personal data; first and last names are required by Lasso.

operations.name: get_contact_information
operations.description: Read email, phone and address collections.

operations.name: set_rating
operations.description: Set a registrant rating, creating that rating if absent.

operations.name: add_email
operations.description: Add one email to a registrant.

operations.name: add_phone
operations.description: Add one phone to a registrant.

operations.name: create_note
operations.description: Append a free-form note to a registrant.

operations.name: list_activities
operations.description: Retrieve up to 150 activities, newest first; Lasso caps this endpoint at 150.

operations.name: create_activity
operations.description: Book a follow-up activity. Completed activities without completedBy are attributed to Lasso Autobot.

operations.name: get_activity
operations.description: Retrieve one registrant activity.

operations.name: list_appointments
operations.description: Retrieve a registrant appointment list.

operations.name: create_appointment
operations.description: Create an appointment using UTC-offset times. Does not request email confirmations or SMS reminders.

operations.name: get_appointment
operations.description: Retrieve one registrant appointment.

operations.name: get_project_settings
operations.description: Read settings, sales reps, ratings, source types and follow-up processes for this API key project.

operations.name: list_activity_types
operations.description: List available activity types for creating follow-up activities.

operations.name: list_inventory
operations.description: List project inventory.

operations.name: get_inventory
operations.description: Retrieve full details for one inventory item.

operations.name: list_project_appointments
operations.description: Read one page of appointments for the project.
